subcategory_text: Privacy personnel understand their roles and responsibilities.
implementation_examples: Provide specialised training to privacy personnel (DPO, privacy engineers, privacy lawyers, privacy architects) covering the technical, legal, and operational dimensions they need
Recognise professional certification and continuing education as evidence of competency
Run case-study based exercises to test competency in ambiguous scenarios
assessment_objectives: Determine whether privacy personnel understand their roles and responsibilities
Determine whether specialised training is provided
Determine whether competency is periodically assessed
Determine whether competency gaps are remediated
